en: Why can I not do this myself: Export or erase a contact on a written request?

steps: Super admin only; every write re-checks the session (fails closed) and is audited with actor and reason
edgeCases: Assistant refuses and offers the merchant-facing alternative or a handoff to Ebda
gaps: Self-service gap: merchant is the data controller; owner DELETE route exists but no screen, so the operator path is the only practical one (audit #10)
operator replaces: contacts.export / contacts.erase (merchant routes exist but erase has no UI)
